name: Arize Phoenix
summary: Open-source LLM tracing and evaluation built on OpenTelemetry, so the spans are not locked to one vendor's format.
description:
Phoenix's most consequential choice is the standard: it speaks OTel, so your traces are already in the format your rest-of-stack instrumentation uses, and swapping tools later does not mean re-instrumenting. Notebook-style evaluation, LLM-as-judge experiments and retrieval diagnostics sit on top, and it runs locally in a few lines, which makes it the easy first step for a team with no observability at all.

It is developer tooling rather than an operations product — alerting, RBAC and long-horizon retention are yours to add. Arize's commercial platform offers the enterprise layer, and teams usually decide at the point where dashboards become someone's on-call responsibility.
